title: Indexer insights
intro: Where each app gets its indexers from, and how every indexer performs over time.

empty.title: No indexers to analyse yet
empty.body: Connect Prowlarr or a Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr instance in Settings. Wardarr then reads their indexers and starts collecting numbers.

hero.label: Successful searches

insight.duplicate: {{app}} has {{name}} twice, next to {{other}}. Every search hits the site twice.
insight.missing_one: Prowlarr should sync {{list}} to {{app}}, but it is missing there.
insight.missing_other: Prowlarr should sync {{count}} indexers to {{app}} that are missing there: {{list}}.
insight.orphan: {{name}} in {{app}} points to an indexer Prowlarr no longer has.
insight.mixed: {{app}} mixes sources: {{synced}} from Prowlarr, {{direct}} added by hand.
insight.directOnly_one: {{app}} has one indexer of its own and is not set up in Prowlarr.
insight.directOnly_other: {{app}} has {{count}} indexers of its own and is not set up in Prowlarr.
insight.unmatchedApp: Prowlarr syncs to {{name}} ({{implementation}}), which Wardarr does not know.
insight.unknownProwlarr: {{name}} in {{app}} comes from a Prowlarr that is not connected to Wardarr.
insight.slow: {{name}} takes {{seconds}} s per answer on average.
insight.noGrabs: {{name}} answered {{queries}} searches without a single grab.
insight.lowImport: Only {{percent}} of grabs from {{name}} made it into the library.
insight.blocked: {{name}} sent {{count}} downloads with blocked files ({{percent}} of its grabs).
insight.best: {{name}} is your strongest indexer with a score of {{score}}.

priorities.title: Priority watchdog

state.off_one: Off. With the current scores it would change 1 priority.
state.off_other: Off. With the current scores it would change {{count}} priorities.
state.settled: Every priority matches the scores. Nothing to change.
state.preview_one: Preview: 1 priority would change at the next run, {{when}}. Nothing is written.
state.preview_other: Preview: {{count}} priorities would change at the next run, {{when}}. Nothing is written.
state.apply_one: 1 priority changes at the next run, {{when}}.
state.apply_other: {{count}} priorities change at the next run, {{when}}.

priorities.enabledHelp: Scores the indexers over the last 30 days and sets matching priorities. A priority that is already right is left alone.
priorities.noScores: No indexer has a score yet. Scores appear once Wardarr has seen searches or grabs.

reason.close: The score moved less than one step, so the priority stays.

tuning.title: Range and steps
tuning.body: The best scored indexer gets the first value. The others move towards the second value by how far they are behind it; 30 score points or more span the whole range. Lower numbers are tried first.
tuning.stepHelp: Priorities move in these steps, so small score changes change nothing.
tuning.invalid: Use whole numbers from 1 to 50, the best below the weakest, and a step from 1 to 10.

apps.title: Where priorities have to be set
apps.intro: Prowlarr passes priorities on only to apps it syncs fully. Everything else is set in the app.
apps.none: No Sonarr, Radarr or other app is connected.

sync.fullSyncBody: {{prowlarr}} passes every priority change on. Nothing to do in the app.
sync.addOnlyBody: {{prowlarr}} only adds and removes indexers here. Priorities have to be set in the app.
sync.disabledBody: {{prowlarr}} does not sync with this app. Priorities have to be set in the app.
sync.noneBody: This app does not get its indexers from Prowlarr. Priorities have to be set in the app.

priorities.includeAppsHelp: For apps Prowlarr does not keep in sync and for indexers added by hand in an app.

log.title: What changed
log.empty: Nothing yet. Each run lists every priority it set or would set.

priorities.scaleNote: Lower numbers are asked first. The shaded band from {{best}} to {{worst}} is where the watchdog places indexers; a ring marks today's value.
